name: read-channel-history
description: Reads the recent messages in a Slack channel, newest first, each with its ts, user id, text, thread ts, reply count and reactions. Takes a channel name or id (list-channels lists them) and reads the workspace's general channel when none is given. A message's ts is what read-thread, reply-in-thread and add-reaction take; find-user names a user id.

channel.description: A channel name, with or without the leading #, or a channel id from list-channels. Omitted, the general channel.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent messages to return.
